repos.description: ShipGuard plugin fixture for offline scout dry-run smoke tests.
repos.readme: ShipGuard validates code audit, process checks, visual review dashboards, smoke tests, sandbox notes, and dry-run preview workflows.

files.content: Creates an isolated fixture, generates review.html, starts a localhost server, verifies JSON contracts, save-manifest, persona reports, and path traversal rejection.
Documents sandbox constraints for local ports, browser sockets, GitHub network calls, dependency installs, and cache writes.
